    float4 gl_Position1 : SV_Position;
    float gl_PointSize1 : PSIZE;

};

static float2 v_uv;

static float2 a_pos;

struct VertexInput {
    float2 a_uv2 : LOC1;
    float2 a_pos2 : LOC0;
};

{

    perVertexStruct.gl_Position = float4(_expr13.x, _expr13.y, 0.0, 1.0);

}

{
